import zlib,struct
d=open('spec.png','rb').read();p=8;idat=b''
while p<len(d):
    l,=struct.unpack('>I',d[p:p+4]);t=d[p+4:p+8];c=d[p+8:p+8+l];p+=12+l
    if t==b'IHDR':w,h,bd,ct=struct.unpack('>IIBB',c[:10])
    if t==b'IDAT':idat+=c
r=zlib.decompress(idat);bpp=3;st=w*bpp;prev=bytearray(st);rows=[];i=0
for y in range(h):
    f=r[i];line=bytearray(r[i+1:i+1+st]);i+=1+st
    for x in range(st):
        a=line[x-bpp] if x>=bpp else 0;b=prev[x];c=prev[x-bpp] if x>=bpp else 0
        if f==1:line[x]=(line[x]+a)&255
        elif f==2:line[x]=(line[x]+b)&255
        elif f==3:line[x]=(line[x]+(a+b)//2)&255
        elif f==4:
            pa=abs(b-c);pb=abs(a-c);pc=abs(a+b-2*c)
            pr=a if pa<=pb and pa<=pc else (b if pb<=pc else c)
            line[x]=(line[x]+pr)&255
    rows.append(line);prev=line
bg=rows[0][:3]
for y in range(2,30,2):
    line=rows[y]
    print(''.join('#' if abs(line[x*3]-bg[0])+abs(line[x*3+1]-bg[1])+abs(line[x*3+2]-bg[2])>150 else '.' for x in range(140,w,2)))
E
